note: wall clock against n_jobs on an Earth chord, at several scan sizes; produced by notebooks/gen_njobs_scaling.py
protocol: every worker count interleaved round-robin, each timed call on a pool warmed inside its own round; 30 rounds for the arms measured with a randomized worker order and 5 for the three carried over; "seconds" is the best pass and "mean_seconds" the mean over rounds, and "speedup" is the ratio of MEANS, which is what the figure plots; the recorded cv is across rounds separated in time rather than across blocks taken back to back

retired_sizes.500 points: not shown in the main figure: the scan runs in 0.4 s, and neither 5 nor 25 interleaved rounds brought its worst coefficient of variation below 0.27, with adjacent worker counts differing by half; it is in the appendix figure instead
retired_sizes.1000 points: shown in the main figure as its smallest size, with a worst cv of 0.13; it reproduced a 20 percent even/odd split three times that is not task division, not points-per-worker and not worker count

migration_note: the three arms carried over were measured before the worker order was randomised, and are marked order="fixed"
topology: i5-1334U: 2 performance cores (hyperthreaded, 4 logical) + 8 efficiency cores = 10 physical, 12 logical
